They belong to the equipment archetype known as [[Korok Gear]], which consists of many Weapons created by Koroks. They are entirely made of wood, and they are both easy to use and strong. They are commonly found in [[Treasure Chest]]s in and around [[Hyrule Ridge]] and the [[Great Hyrule Forest]]. Being made of wood, Forest Dweller's Spears will float when dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. While they will not conduct [[Electricity]] or attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s, they will burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]].
